description: The nfs-interview skill dispatches the interviewer agent to conduct the ten-section project intake and write context/brief.md.

cases.given: nfs-interview runs because the author wants to start a new nonfiction book project
cases.expect: interviewer agent is dispatched to conduct the intake interview

cases.given: nfs-interview runs for a book about professional learning networks
cases.expect: interviewer is invoked and begins the ten-section intake sequence
